nd-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
nd-county-officials.why: No statewide list of North Dakota's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
nd-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

nd-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app names the mayor and commission or council of six of North Dakota's seven cities of 25,000 people or more, and not those of Williston or the smaller cities.
nd-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of North Dakota's city officials has been read for this app. The six are read from each city's own pages; Williston's own page names no commissioner, and the smaller cities' pages have not been read.
nd-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of every city's mayor and commission or council, kept current, and Williston's own page naming its five commissioners.

nd-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
nd-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of North Dakota's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
nd-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

nd-township-officers.summary: Where a township has a government of its own, the Township or City card says so and does not name its officers.
nd-township-officers.why: No list of North Dakota's township officers has been read for this app yet, statewide or county by county.
nd-township-officers.wanted: A statewide list of township officers, or each county's or township's own published list of them.

nd-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website where they are known. It does not name any nation's council yet.
nd-tribal-government.why: This app has not read any North Dakota nation's council list yet. Each nation publishes its own, which has to be read one nation at a time.
nd-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, read one nation at a time.
